message.content: {"0": {"original": "Joost secures deals with Warner Brothers, Time Warner, and Sony Pictures to be a", "rephrased": "The startup Joost is advancing the Internet TV model by securing content agreements with major providers like Warner Brothers, Time Warner, and Sony Pictures to offer flexible, on-demand programming that balances consumer choice with industry control, though it currently lacks the high-quality content of traditional cable and relies on advertising revenue.", "summary": "Joost advances Internet TV by securing major content deals to balance consumer choice with industry control, despite lacking high-quality cable content and relying on ads."}, "1": {"original": "Joost balances consumer choice with industry control but lacks high-quality", "rephrased": "The entertainment industry and consumers have conflicting needs regarding television distribution, with the former requiring content control and the latter seeking increased flexibility; the startup Joost attempts to resolve this tension by leveraging peer-to-peer technology to deliver on-demand programming, yet the service currently suffers from lower content quality compared to established cable systems and must generate revenue through advertising.", "summary": "Joost attempts to balance consumer flexibility with industry content control via peer-to-peer technology, though it currently lacks high-quality content and relies on advertising."}}
